name: Duplicant — takes P/T and creature types of the last creature card exiled with it
notes: Memories: project_imprint_implementation_2026-05-25 and project_imprint_followup_fixes_2026-05-25. Elves is imprinted first and Vampire Nighthawk second, so Duplicant becomes 2/3 with the Nighthawk's creature types (still a Shapeshifter, never Elf or Druid). A Bears exiled with a different permanent (an untagged exile entry) must not matter. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build in its own process.
